newsitem.title: USA: Jury rules against Dow Jones in $223 million libel case.
newsitem.headline: Jury rules against Dow Jones in $223 million libel case.

text.p: A federal jury on Thursday awarded $222.7 million in damages to principals in a now-defunct securities firm in a libel suit against Dow Jones & Co. Inc.

The jury's verdict followed a two-week trial in which MMAR Group Inc. said it was forced out of business in 1993 following a critical article published in the Wall Street Journal. Attorneys for Dow Jones & Co., which publishes the Journal, said they planned to appeal.
